title: ELEMENT: Episodic and Lifelong Exploration via Maximum Entropy
abstract: arXiv:2412.03800v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reinforcement learning agents depend on reward signals whose density is rarely under the designer's control, and when such signals are absent, an agent must generate its own drive to explore. State entropy maximization offers a principled objective for this, but existing methods break down at scale in two ways: the intrinsic reward vanishes once a state has been visited, discouraging revisits to the very gateways that lead onward, and estimating entropy over millions of accumulated observations becomes computationally prohibitive. We address both with Episodic and Lifelong Exploration via Maximum Entropy (ELEMENT), a multiscale intrinsically motivated framework for reward-free exploration that transfers to downstream tasks. ELEMENT couples lifelong entropy maximization with a complementary episodic term acting on a faster timescale. translated_title: ELEMENT：基于最大熵的情景化与终身探索
translated_abstract: 强化学习智能体依赖于奖励信号，而奖励信号的密度很少在设计者的掌控之中；当此类信号缺失时，智能体必须自行产生探索的驱动力。状态熵最大化为此提供了一个有原则的目标，但现有方法在大规模场景下存在两方面的问题：一是内在奖励在状态被访问过一次后便会消失，从而阻碍了对那些通往后续区域的“门户”状态的再次访问；二是在数百万条累积观测上估计熵在计算上变得难以承受。我们通过“基于最大熵的情景化与终身探索”（ELEMENT）同时解决了这两个问题，这是一个多尺度的内在动机框架，用于无奖励探索并能迁移到下游任务。ELEMENT 将终身熵最大化与一个在更快时间尺度上起作用的互补性情景项相结合。对于情景项，我们推导出了平均情景状态熵，这是一种内在奖励，它是……
tldr: ELEMENT 提出了一个多尺度内在动机探索框架，将终身熵最大化与平均情景状态熵相结合，同时解决了现有状态熵最大化方法中内在奖励消失导致门户状态无法重访、以及大规模熵估计计算开销过高这两大问题。
en_tdlr: ELEMENT is a multiscale intrinsically motivated framework for reward-free exploration that couples lifelong entropy maximization with average episodic state entropy, addressing both the vanishing intrinsic reward problem and the computational intractability of large-scale entropy estimation.
